Nestle India Shares Decline Amid Inflation Concerns

Nestle India's shares experienced a significant drop, falling approximately 9% over two days. This decline occurred despite the company reporting a 36% profit growth in the second quarter. The company flagged inflation risks as a concern for its future performance, contributing to investor apprehension about high valuations.
